type.description: `delta` carries incremental `text`; `done` closes with the token/cost accounting; `error` aborts; `metering_failed` means the RESPONSE went out but the cost was not accounted for — the frame exists so that failure does not go unnoticed.

estimated.description: Only on `done`. `true` when the provider did not return a count and the cost was ESTIMATED — the number is worth less and the UI needs to be able to say so.

400.description: Invalid body. The `ValidationPipe` runs with `whitelist` and `forbidNonWhitelisted`, so an unknown field also fails.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
